therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: New Formulation of rebif (interferon beta-1a) vs Betaseron (interferon beta-1b)
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: immunomodulation / reduction of inflammatory activity in CNS
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with Relapsing Remitting Multiple Sclerosis (RRMS)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in Mean VAS for the 21 Full-dose Injections at Pre-injection and 30 Minutes Post-injection Timepoints

results.effect_size: Mean change in VAS: New Formulation of Rebif 0.67 mm vs Betaseron 1.14 mm (difference not statistically significant)
subgroup_findings: Mean Pre-Injection VAS Score: New Formulation of Rebif 0.43 mm vs Betaseron 0.40 mm
Mean VAS at 30 minutes Post-Injection: New Formulation of Rebif 1.10 mm vs Betaseron 1.54 mm
Mean Change to 30 Minutes Post-Injection: New Formulation of Rebif 0.67 mm vs Betaseron 1.14 mm (p=0.524)
safety_signals: Serious adverse events were infrequent and distributed across both arms
Accidental overdose reported in both arms (1 each)
Chronic hepatitis reported in New Formulation of Rebif arm
Cholecystitis and cholelithiasis reported across arms
No notable safety signal differentiating the two formulations

dose_info.dose: New Formulation of Rebif: 44 mcg SC; Betaseron: 250 mcg SC
dose_info.schedule: New Formulation of Rebif: three times weekly (tiw); Betaseron: every other day

context.duration: 12 weeks (titration + full-dose phase) with extension phase
